## What

Describe what this PR changes and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] The full project banner header is present on every new/changed authored file.
- [ ] Code and comments are in English; no em/en-dashes (use `-`).
- [ ] Changes to the SSH server itself stay in `patches/` as small, auditable patches against upstream Dropbear - not vendored source.
- [ ] No secrets, keys, device configuration or personal data are committed.
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or configuration changed (`README`, `docs/`, `CHANGELOG.md`).
- [ ] The module still builds (`scripts/build.sh`) and, if bundles changed, (`scripts/build-bundles.sh`).

## Notes

Anything a reviewer should know (trade-offs, follow-ups, testing done).
